summary.text: Cathy Smythe is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 98 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Gabe Woolley (R).
Ballotpedia lists her career as an information technology professional and data analyst.

paragraphs.text: Cathy Smythe earned a high school diploma from West Springfield High School, an associate degree from Northern Virginia Community College in 1976, a bachelor's degree from Excelsior College in 1990, and a graduate degree from the University of Memphis in 2000.
Ballotpedia says she has been affiliated with the Alliance Française de Tulsa and Tulsa Global Alliance.
Smythe ran for District 98 in 2024 and lost to Woolley, receiving 33.3 percent of the vote to his 66.7 percent.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mom, IT consultant with a 42-year career, education believer and church business manager.
In her 2026 survey, Smythe listed strong public schools, affordable and available healthcare for all Oklahomans, and applying her technology experience to policy decisions as her key messages.
